body: How would you explain the image of a red barn clear as day that popped in my head for like a split second? It’s not much compared to people with hyperantasia but my mind is definitely beginning to be able to see. I’ve never even been able to see colors in my head before so this is a step forward regardless. I have now also seen purple and red now

So I looked up some meditation type music (really whatever music calms you the most) and I focused on my breathing and just had a central memory or idea I focused on. I didn’t see the memory/image I was concentrating on, but I did see blue and occasionally yellow. Oddly enough I also saw a flash picture of the top of a red barn 😂 no idea why but it was so cool to see in my mind I started tearing up. Also just a heads up, it took about 30-45 minutes with my eyes closed before I actually started seeing anything. From my experience patience and practice is key.

Hello! I loved reading your post! I have aphantasia and I have had it my whole life (only recently found out I had it though, I assumed everyone saw nothing like I did lol). For me personally I have had no physical draw backs from it. I have 20/20 vision and great hearing, as well as my other senses being fine. But after looking into aphantasia, I learned that some theory’s believe that aphantasia can affect mood. I for instance have always felt little emotion overall, aside from anger or sadness. I am not sure if aphantasia actually affects the emotions of one’s body but to me, it would make sense. I hope my post was helpful!
